And the number is not even good: the CLASSICAL centroider measures
0.141 px on the same graded metric (just sweep, clear air, 30 s). A
learned centroider that scores 0.274 px on dummy data would be a
REGRESSION if it were real. That ordering is the argument for targeting
CandidateNet first — the decoy and clutter cases, where the classical
path genuinely fails — rather than CentroidNet, where it does not.
